text:
```yaml
name: Claude PR Critique

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  build_and_critique:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install and test web
        run: |
          cd web
          npm ci
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm test

      - name: Install and test apps
        run: |
          cd apps
          npm ci
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm test

      - name: Install and test electron
        run: |
          cd electron
          npm ci
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck
          npm test

      - name: Claude PR critique
        uses: anthropic/claude@v1
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        with:
          prompt: |
            Please provide a short critique of the following pull request:
            Title: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
            Body: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
            Diff URL: ${{ github.event.pull_request.diff_url }}
          model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620
          temperature: 0.7
          max_tokens: 200
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
